summary: The player fights the boss (The Warden) in Phase 3, using focus mode to weave through curved waves of pink bullets while releasing charged wave shots against the boss.

events.evidence: Small white arc projectile fired from player ship after cannon bar reaches 1 pip, accompanied by a firing sound.
Circular focus ring with 'PISTOL' label appears around the player ship as it slows down.
Arc projectile impacts the bottom of the heart-shaped boss; boss flashes briefly.
Wider white arc projectile released from player ship after cannon meter fills to 2 pips.
Circular ring appears around the player ship while weaving between bullets.
Charged arc hits the boss, which flashes bright white, and the boss health bar decreases slightly.
Wide white arc shot fired upward from player ship.
Arc impacts the boss, causing a bright white flash on the heart core.
Smaller white arc fired upward from player ship.
Focus ring appears around player ship.
Arc hits the boss, making it flash pure white.

readability_issues.issue: When the focus ring activates around the player ship, its bright white/cyan fill partially obscures nearby pink enemy bullets entering the ring.
The bright white flash on the player ship when charging/releasing a shot momentarily obscures the ship's exact hitbox against nearby pink bullets.
